story.greek_salad_memory_01: The guys across the way used to make this salad. Once we climbed into a neighbor's garden for olives. We really wanted to make everything fresh.
story.greek_salad_memory_02: One night we went swimming. We fished snails out with our feet. We walked back barefoot, carrying our shoes.
story.greek_salad_memory_03: We traveled to festivals in other towns. Slept on the floor, then got up to watch the performances and put on our own.
story.greek_salad_memory_04: We'd get back from conferences at night and go to class in the morning. Only cafeteria coffee and a 'goodbye, liver' pastry kept us going.
story.greek_salad_memory_05: It's been ages since I went off somewhere like that… Always something to do. At least there's time for a salad. It only takes ten minutes.
story.bundt_cake_memory_01: Harry and I used to sit in this kitchen and talk for hours. It's a bit cramped for two, but somehow we always had enough room.
story.bundt_cake_memory_02: Once we made wine at Harry's place. He had a cellar. Best wine of my life. I even drew a label. We called it 'RusAlco'.
story.bundt_cake_memory_03: Harry and I once took a trip to a nearby town. That night we sat on a hill under a streetlight and listened to Where Is My Mind.
story.bundt_cake_memory_04: I used to just knock on Harry's door: 'Want to go for a walk?' He never even asked how long we'd be out. He just came along.
story.bundt_cake_memory_05: Harry and I studied for exams together, too. We'd take a break to play a game… Then we'd have to take a break from the game.
story.bundt_cake_memory_06: Once I got so drunk that Harry had to untie my shoelaces. I tried to help, but I think I only made the knots tighter.
story.bundt_cake_memory_07: On our last day of classes, we rode the Ferris wheel. We could see our campus from the top. It felt strange knowing we didn't have to go back.
story.bundt_cake_memory_08: Harry and I once made all these plans to meet up. Then I went and broke my leg. We met anyway. All that planning had to count for something!
story.bundt_cake_memory_09: I met Harry in my first year. We both had to dress up for a performance. One joke led to another, and suddenly we were friends.
story.bundt_cake_memory_10: Then Harry moved to another city. At first I kept wanting to invite him out for the evening, but he couldn't just come over anymore.
story.bundt_cake_memory_11: Last time Harry visited, he asked where I kept the cups. It caught me off guard. He'd always known.
story.bundt_cake_memory_12: No matter how much time passes, I know Harry and I can pick up right where we left off, as if those years apart never happened.
story.pie_memory_01: Cecilia used to make cherry pie like this. We could never wait for it to cool. We'd eat it hot, dropping cherries on the floor.
story.pie_memory_02: Once Cecilia and I used rock-paper-scissors to decide where to go, how to get there, and how many stops to make. We ended up at a huge mall.
story.pie_memory_03: Cecilia and I used to call each other and talk for hours. About shows and games, plans and worries. Sometimes we'd even belt out songs.
story.pie_memory_04: I've still got lots of videos with Cecilia. We filmed silly sketches and TV parodies. Ahead of our time.
story.pie_memory_05: Cecilia taught me to skateboard. Well, I learned the first lesson. I know all the proper ways to fall.
story.pie_memory_06: One summer Cecilia invited me to a celebration in town. We splashed each other with water from the fountain and jumped in. We went home soaking wet.
story.pie_memory_07: Then we started calling less often. Sometimes I'd want to tell her something, but I'd think: it's late. I'll message Cecilia tomorrow.
story.pie_memory_08: We never even had a fight. One day I just realized I no longer knew what an ordinary day looked like for Cecilia.
story.pie_memory_09: I still have those videos. I even posted one online. It hasn't had many views. I wonder if any of them were hers.
story.pie_memory_10: I don't know what kind of pie Cecilia makes now. Maybe something completely different. But I'll try this one… I think it's cooled down.
story.dressed_herring_memory_01: When I was a kid, the whole family would get together for celebrations. Dressed herring was always on the table. For years I thought the party couldn't start without it.
story.dressed_herring_memory_02: They'd bring out the special dishes. That's how I knew someone was coming over, even before anyone told me.
story.dressed_herring_memory_03: They hid the presents beforehand. I honestly tried not to look. But sometimes I happened to peek exactly where I shouldn't.
story.dressed_herring_memory_04: While the grown-ups cooked, I'd sneak raw dumplings. Why raw? They used to ask me that, too.
story.dressed_herring_memory_05: I took it for granted: a celebration would come around, and everyone would gather. It never crossed my mind that someone might not be able to make it.
story.dressed_herring_memory_06: Now I do the cooking myself, and I'm always remembering something else I need to do. How did they get so much done while I was hunting for presents?
story.dressed_herring_memory_07: I brought out the good dishes today, too. I keep saving them for a special occasion… A birthday seems to count.
story.cake_memory_01: Well, we've made it to the cake! It's my birthday today. All morning I've been swinging between feeling happy and counting up what I should have done by now.
story.cake_memory_02: I wanted a party like the ones we had when I was little. A table covered in treats, with a little left over for tomorrow.
story.cake_memory_03: Cooking brought back so many memories. Even things I hadn't thought about in years. I hope I haven't talked your ear off?
story.cake_memory_04: There have been so many good things. Somehow, when I take stock of my life, I don't always count them. I really should.
story.cake_memory_05: I'm surrounded by wonderful people. Step by step, I'm working toward my goal. Thank you for supporting me!
story.cake_memory_06: Here, have a slice. I've been looking forward to this so much. Thank you for coming!
